description_en: Saves a reusable semantic task definition. If you use a single-file source, apply for and complete the attachment upload first. After the definition is created, call RunSemanticJob with the returned Name
description_zh: 保存可复用的语义任务定义。若使用单文件来源，请先申请并完成附件上传；创建成功后用返回的 Name 调用 RunSemanticJob
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-semantic-job --name semantic-job-demo --resource-group-id rg-demo --source '{"pinnedScopeInfo":[{"name":"mc_project","type":"project"}],"domain":"sales","type":"maxcompute"}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSemanticJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the semantic task, which is also the task identifier for subsequent calls to RunSemanticJob, DeleteSemanticJob, ListSemanticJobRuns, and DownloadSemanticResults. The name must be unique within the current tenant
parameters.help_zh: 语义任务名称，也是后续 RunSemanticJob、DeleteSemanticJob、ListSemanticJobRuns 和 DownloadSemanticResults 的任务标识。名称须在当前租户内唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. This parameter is required unless `Source.type` is set to `singleTableFile`. The `Data.ProjectId` in the creation result can be reused for GetSemanticJobDetail, GetSemanticJobLog, and KillSemanticJob
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks 工作空间 ID。除 Source.type=singleTableFile 外均应提供；创建结果的 Data.ProjectId 可复用于 GetSemanticJobDetail、GetSemanticJobLog 和 KillSemanticJob
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the resource group used to run the semantic task. You do not need to pass this parameter when calling RunSemanticJob. The resource group saved during creation is used
parameters.help_zh: 运行语义任务使用的资源组标识。RunSemanticJob 不再传该参数，而是使用创建时保存的资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The input data source configuration for the semantic task. The type field is required. The configuration specifies the data to analyze. This configuration is distinct from the semantic_model YAML generated by the task. The domain field is a string that identifies the business domain and focus area for the task, such as sales. Supported data sources include the following. 1) maxcompute: Specify the scope by using pinnedScopeInfo. Array elements include type and name. If type is project, name is the MaxCompute project name. If type is schema, project is the project name and name is the schema name. For a table-level scope, project is the project name, schema is optional, and name is the table name. 2) holo or starrocks: In addition to type, you must specify dataSourceName and dataSourceEnv, and include ProjectId at the top level of the request. You can use pinnedScopeInfo to restrict the scope to a schema or table. The name element represents the schema or table name. For a table-level scope, schema represents the database or schema to which the table belongs. 3) singleTableFile: ProjectId is not required. For file reference rules, refer to ReferenceFileIds and ReferenceFileUris. After the task runs successfully, call DownloadSemanticResults to retrieve result files such as the semantic_model YAML. The example demonstrates a MaxCompute project scope
parameters.help_zh: 语义任务的输入数据源配置，必须传入 type；它用于选择待分析的数据，不是任务产出的 semantic_model YAML。domain 为字符串，用于标识本次任务关注的业务域及关注点，例如 sales。支持：1）maxcompute：通过 pinnedScopeInfo 指定范围；数组元素包含 type、name，type=project 时 name 为 MaxCompute 项目名，type=schema 时 project 为项目名、name 为 Schema 名，表级范围时 project 为项目名、schema 可选、name 为表名。2）holo 或 starrocks：除 type 外还需传 dataSourceName、dataSourceEnv，并在请求顶层传入 ProjectId；可用 pinnedScopeInfo 限定 schema 或表范围，元素的 name 为 schema 或表名，表级范围的 schema 为所在库或 Schema。3）singleTableFile：无需 ProjectId，文件引用规则见 ReferenceFileIds 和 ReferenceFileUris。任务成功运行后，请通过 DownloadSemanticResults 获取 semantic_model YAML 等结果文件。示例为 MaxCompute 项目范围
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The list of IDs of uploaded reference files. If `Source.type` is set to `singleTableFile`, this parameter and `ReferenceFileUris` are mutually exclusive, and the selected array must contain exactly one non-empty element. The ID must be obtained from `Data.FileId` returned by UploadSemanticFile, and the file only supports CSV or XLSX formats. For other `Source.type` values, you can pass multiple IDs. The service validates each ID during creation, and you can pass `ReferenceFileUris` at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 已上传参考文件 ID 列表。Source.type=singleTableFile 时，与 ReferenceFileUris 二选一，且所选数组必须恰有一个非空元素；该 ID 应来自 UploadSemanticFile 的 Data.FileId，并且文件仅支持 CSV 或 XLSX。其他 Source.type 可传入多个 ID；服务会在创建时校验每个 ID，且可同时传入 ReferenceFileUris
parameters.name: reference_file_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of URIs of reference files accessible to the caller. If `Source.type` is set to `singleTableFile`, this parameter and `ReferenceFileIds` are mutually exclusive, and the selected array must contain exactly one non-empty URI. For other `Source.type` values, you can pass multiple URIs, and you can pass `ReferenceFileIds` at the same time. When using the upload path of UploadSemanticFile, pass `Data.FileId` after the PUT upload is completed, instead of the short-lived `UploadUrl`
parameters.help_zh: 调用方可访问的参考文件 URI 列表。Source.type=singleTableFile 时，与 ReferenceFileIds 二选一，且所选数组必须恰有一个非空 URI。其他 Source.type 可传入多个 URI，且可同时传入 ReferenceFileIds。使用 UploadSemanticFile 的上传路径时，应在 PUT 上传完成后传其 Data.FileId，而非短期有效的 UploadUrl
parameters.name: reference_file_uris

schema.description_en: The standard response for creating a semantic task. `Data` contains the saved task definition. Subsequent calls use the `Name`, `ProjectId`, and reference file information in `Data`
schema.description_zh: 创建语义任务的标准响应。Data 为已保存的任务定义，后续调用通过其中的 Name、ProjectId 和参考文件信息衔接

Data.description_en: The saved semantic task definition. Use `Data.Name` to call RunSemanticJob, DeleteSemanticJob, ListSemanticJobRuns, and DownloadSemanticResults
Data.description_zh: 已保存的语义任务定义。使用 Data.Name 调用 RunSemanticJob、DeleteSemanticJob、ListSemanticJobRuns 和 DownloadSemanticResults

Creator.description_en: The identifier of the task creator, which has the same value as `UserId` and identifies who created the task
Creator.description_zh: 任务创建者标识，等同于 UserId，用于展示创建归属

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the task definition was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 任务定义创建时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the task definition was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 任务定义最近修改时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳

Id.description_en: The internal unique ID of the task definition, which is used to identify the created task
Id.description_zh: 任务定义的内部唯一 ID，用于标识本次创建的任务

Name.description_en: The saved task name. This value is used for subsequent operations such as running, deleting, querying run records, and downloading results
Name.description_zh: 已保存的任务名称；后续运行、删除、查询运行记录和下载结果均使用该值

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the task belongs. This ID is used as the `ProjectId` for GetSemanticJobDetail, GetSemanticJobLog, and KillSemanticJob
ProjectId.description_zh: 任务所属 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；用于 GetSemanticJobDetail、GetSemanticJobLog 和 KillSemanticJob 的 ProjectId

ReferenceFileIds.description_en: The list of IDs of associated uploaded files. If the source type is `singleTableFile`, the task reads the only file in the list at runtime
ReferenceFileIds.description_zh: 已关联的上传文件 ID 列表；singleTableFile 运行时读取其中的唯一文件

items.description_en: The `FileId` returned by UploadSemanticFile. Use it after completing the PUT upload
items.description_zh: 由 UploadSemanticFile 返回并完成 PUT 上传后的 FileId

ReferenceFileUris.description_en: The list of URIs of associated external reference files. If the source type is `singleTableFile`, the task reads the only file in the list at runtime
ReferenceFileUris.description_zh: 已关联的外部参考文件 URI 列表；singleTableFile 运行时读取其中的唯一文件

items.description_en: The URI of an accessible reference file provided by the caller
items.description_zh: 调用方提供的可访问参考文件 URI

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The identifier of the resource group to be used when running this task
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 运行本任务时将使用的资源组标识

Source.description_en: The saved input data source configuration, which corresponds to `Source` in the creation request. The data scope to be analyzed is selected based on this config during runtime
Source.description_zh: 已保存的输入数据源配置，与创建请求中的 Source 对应；运行时据此选择待分析的数据范围

Type.description_en: The saved `Source.type` data source type, which is used to quickly identify the task input type
Type.description_zh: 已保存的 Source.type 数据源类型，用于快速识别任务输入类型

UserId.description_en: The identifier of the user who created the task
UserId.description_zh: 创建该任务的用户标识

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
